changes.title: F/S R-07-268 — Bike Boulevards (enacted R-2007-109, 2007)
changes.description: Historical 2007 legislation designating Mountain Road, Silver Avenue, and 14th Street bike-boulevard routes; phased Silver Avenue implementation; up to $400,000 in Fund 340 funding for design, engineering, and initial implementation; bikeway-plan amendments and crossing coordination; and the final-version 18 mph provision. Not necessarily current consolidated law.
